resources.string: Used for legacy Chinese/English recognition and voice wake-up. Using these features again requires another download after deletion.
No model files on this device
Free approximately %1$s. Legacy recognition and voice wake-up share this model and will need to download it again. Settings will be kept.
Voice features still hold this model. Turn off voice wake-up, close voice windows and switch the recognition engine, then retry.
Transcription fills the message box. Nothing is sent automatically.
Allow microphone access to use voice to text.
Try SenseVoice first if unsure. Choose Paraformer for a smaller download.
Try AISHELL3 for fast Chinese speech. Choose Melo for English or mixed Chinese and English.
Based on official information and public tests, not a ranking on your phone. Download size is not runtime memory usage. Try your selected profile to compare speed and results.
Free approximately %1$s. You will need to download it again to use it. Voice profiles will be kept.
Switch this profile to another model before deleting.
Some files could not be deleted. Please try again.
Finish or cancel the model download before deleting.
Supports Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese and Korean. Transcribes after each utterance; larger download.
For Chinese or English with less storage use. Transcribes after each utterance; smaller size does not guarantee faster recognition.
For everyday Chinese speech, with 174 voices. Faster synthesis in public tests; limited detail, closer to telephone audio.
For mixed Chinese and English, with one voice. Higher audio sample rate, but more compute and potentially longer waits. Listen to decide which voice you prefer.
Runs on your phone without uploading audio. Downloads require confirmation; existing models remain available.
Transcribed. Edit and send when ready.
Speech stopped. The task is still running.
Experimental: interrupt supported players using wired, USB or LE Audio headphones, then review and send.
Interruption transcribed. Review and send; the current task continues.
Pitch control unavailable for this model
Playback failed. Check speech settings; the text response continues.
